title: Validation v1
description: config/validation/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F6a, D-354): a validation criterion, the evidence in use that a need or a requirement is met (ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 validation): what it validates and either its own measure/comparator/threshold/window or a reference (`nc`) to its canonical necessary condition in config/problem/. Its state is derived by scripts/model from the measure (met, not-met, measuring while the window is short, defined while no source is wired), never written.

nc.description: Canonical necessary condition (config/problem/NC-*.json) whose measure, comparator, threshold and window this validation references instead of duplicating them (D-354).

kind.description: merges-per-day: merges on main's first-parent line per complete UTC day, averaged over the window's days; trailer-rate: the share of merges whose commits carry `trailer`, over the window's merges; escape-rate: the share of the window's merged changes that an escape (INC-escape-<n>, from a later merge's `Fixes-PR:` trailer) was introduced by; model-share: a share scripts/model computes (`name`); incident-count: the incident records (scripts/incident) of kind `incident` opened over the window's days; code-scan: the sleep calls inside a loop in the code under `paths` less `exclude` (globs), the candidates for polling; all-met: how many of the validations `of` are not met, measuring while any is short of data or has no source; run-durations: the `percentile` of the durations in a recorded snapshot of `workflow` (config/validation/runs/: a GitHub workflow's runs by scripts/runs, or `deploy`, the AWS deploy's succeeded builds by scripts/deploy status), measuring while it holds fewer than `min_runs` runs or is older than `max_age_days`; aws-spend: the AWS account's unblended spend for the month to date in US$, from the snapshot of the deploy build's daily Cost Explorer reading (config/validation/spend/aws.json, scripts/spend), measuring while it is of another month or older than `max_age_days` (a reading of this month over the threshold is final); supplier-spend: a supplier's spend in US$ from a reading checked by hand against its invoice (config/validation/spend/<supplier>.json, scripts/lib/spend.py read_supplier), measuring once older than `max_age_days` (D-342); unwired: no source is wired yet (`source` says which). slo: the value of one SLO of config/registry/slo.json (`name`) in its GitHub snapshot (config/validation/slo.json), fresh while the snapshot is (D-348).

threshold_key.description: A registry key whose value is the threshold (D-342), so the number lives in one key. A validation carries threshold or threshold_key, exactly one (scripts/model read_validations refuses both or neither: a oneOf here would not be an additive change of v1).
